items.q: How long does a custom practice website take?
items.a: Typical timeline is 4 to 6 weeks from kickoff to launch, depending on page count and content readiness. We move faster with structured milestones and weekly reviews.
We build with HIPAA-aware architecture — encrypted forms, secure hosting with BAA-ready partners, no PHI in analytics, and audit trails on submissions.

items.q: Do I own the design and code?
items.a: Yes. On launch, full ownership of design files, code, and content transfers to you. No lock-in, no proprietary CMS.
Keyword-mapped H1/H2 structure, schema markup (LocalBusiness, MedicalClinic, FAQ), optimized meta, internal linking, and image alt/optimization across every page.

items.q: Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
items.a: Yes. Our Website Care plans cover updates, security, backups, uptime monitoring, performance tuning, and monthly content edits.
